version: v3 · v2 plus a post-quantum guardian for the verifier key; QCAI stage 3
source: contracts/ClainovaClaimsV3.sol at commit a24cb56 (the source QCAI stage 3 reviewed)
runtimeCheck: Identical to the solc 0.8.28 build of the source except the two immutable slots holding the token address.
registration: reused from v1 (possession-proven key already registered)

deployment.note: Diana's RPC refuses gas estimates above 5,000,000, so the limit was set by hand from a local measurement (5,281,195; v2 matched Diana to 0.005%). The transaction itself was accepted.

guardianCheck.note: Freeze, then rotate to the same verifier key, both signed by the guardian's ML-DSA-87 key and checked by pqcVerify (0x0a01) on Diana. A claim() call answered 'Claims frozen' between them and 'Payment closed' (unknown id) after. The verifier key never changed.
